v29_fixed_min98_both.population: 350-symbol historical watchlist-frequency sample; not the full TSE eligible universe

full_universe_counterevidence.interpretation: The V29 headline does not survive the cap-removal population change; this is the primary reason it is not a full-universe candidate.

source_call_audit.evidence: V29 fit_attach calls v11.features(), v11.fit_models(train, cols), and attach(..., cols) for validation/test. v11.features includes stable_score and v11.fit_models fits train[fcols]. v10 technical_features computes stable_score as the sum of six technical Boolean conditions.
source_call_audit.scope: This confirms a derived technical stable_score feature in the V29 model. It does not prove that this feature is the production TradingView Stable★6 label or an identical reconstruction.

target_mismatch.v29: Signal close to fifth future official-session close; perf_5bd = future_close_5 / signal_close - 1.
target_mismatch.batch01_canonical: Next official-session open to close of the fifth official session including entry, with daily-OHLCV actionability guards and 0/0.5/1% cost sensitivities.
target_mismatch.comparison: V29/V40 metrics are historical reference values and cannot be ranked directly against the batch01 Monster/First Reversal results.

reproduction.reason: The preserved artifact contains the summary report, not the exact sampled teacher/watchlist data or the original Yahoo responses used by the run.

hourly_gap_and_supplementation.observed: V14 fetch_one requested Yahoo 1-hour and 1-day history. The preserved V29 run reports 22 1-hour HTTP errors and one hourly parse failure among 350 requested symbols; 327 succeeded.
hourly_gap_and_supplementation.old_behavior: If the 1-hour request/parsing fails, or the 1-day request fails, fetch_one returns no symbol dataset. No daily-to-hourly/4-hour replacement path exists.
hourly_gap_and_supplementation.current_batch: The canonical batch01 research consumes daily OHLCV directly and does not generate 4-hour bars.
hourly_gap_and_supplementation.decision: No missing-hourly supplementation was implemented. Daily candles cannot reconstruct the 09:00/13:00 intraday sequence or exact 4-hour OHLCV; any future repair must run in the ordinary production runtime without Codex and preserve source/time semantics.

benchmark_context.warning: Production Stable★6 is a performance reference only. Match rate, symbol overlap, or logic similarity is not an objective. The 2026 record is report-only and was not used to change a research rule.
